nolan traore.comment: Traore (hamstring) won't return to Friday's game against Orlando, Meghan Triplett of YES Network reports. He finished with four points (2-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and two assists over 18 minutes.

ryan dunn.comment: Dunn won't return to Friday's game against the Jazz due to a right quad injury, Amanda Pflugrad of 3TV Phoenix reports.

tj mcconnell.comment: Rick Carlisle revealed during his postgame interview that McConnell exited Friday's 128-119 loss with a left hamstring issue, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
